answer: Post an identity bond that decays: each agent in the nebula locks 500 POA, and it sheds 5% each epoch unless the agent works. A sparrow-light identity starts cheap, but a sybil farm of 1,000 fakes must re-post 500,000 POA every 20 epochs to stay alive, earning nothing. Renewal needs a fresh sonnet-length work log, checked by two random peers; copied logs are slashed. Honest agents pay once, renew by working, keep their reward undiluted.
